Using ordinate \(1\): the point satisfies \(x^2=2p\), so its distance to the focus \((0,p/2)\) is

\[
\sqrt{x^2+\left(1-\frac p2\right)^2}=3.
\]

Since \(x^2=2p\),

\[
2p+\left(1-\frac p2\right)^2=9
\]

\[
1+p+\frac{p^2}{4}=9
\]

\[
p^2+4p-32=0
\]

\[
(p-4)(p+8)=0.
\]

Since \(p>0\), \(p=4\). The focus-directrix distance is \(p\).

\[
\boxed{4}
\]
